NAME: Matbench
TYPE: component
DIRECT_CLAIMS: CHGNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Matbench Discovery benchmark, outperforming eight other submitted models.

DIRECT_CLAIMS: The PET model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on matbench-discovery benchmark (DAF=6.075, Accuracy=0.977, F1=0.924) and exceeds SOTA on SPICE molecular benchmark across most subsets for both energy and force predictions.
DIRECT_CLAIMS: Conservative PET-OAM models achieve state-of-the-art performance on phonon tasks in matbench-discovery and the best overall accuracy in predicting shear modulus among tested models.

DIRECT_CLAIMS: Elastic moduli predictions are very sensitive to the lack of energy conservation in MLIP models, and non-conservative models consistently perform worse on matbench-discovery downstream tasks despite achieving better training and validation accuracies.
ARTICLE: Benchmarking Materials Property Prediction Methods: The Matbench Test Set and Automatminer Reference Algorithm

NAME: Universal MLIPs
TYPE: method
DIRECT_CLAIMS: Universal MLIPs trained on massive datasets can generalize across diverse chemical systems and can be successfully applied to structural optimization and lattice dynamics workflows.
DIRECT_CLAIMS: Each cataloged DFT structure provides one energy and 3N forces (N = number of atoms) for training universal MLIPs.
DIRECT_CLAIMS: Universal MLIPs attempt to cover 10-100 elements under varying levels of constraints.
DIRECT_CLAIMS: Orb-v3-direct-* models are the only universal MLIPs that can compute hundreds of forward passes per second, exceeding one million steps per hour for small systems.
ARTICLE: Pushing the limits of unconstrained machine-learned interatomic potentials

TYPE: method
DIRECT_CLAIMS: Phonax efficiently predicts phonon dispersion relations and density of states for inorganic crystal materials.

DIRECT_CLAIMS: Including Hessian (second‑derivative) data in training improves the energy model accuracy beyond training with only energy and force data, reduces force MAE, and provides an effective ~7× increase in the amount of force information.
DIRECT_CLAIMS: Augmenting a minimal 1×1×1 supercell training set with Hessian data yields more accurate phonon predictions than training on a larger 3×3×3 supercell alone.
DIRECT_CLAIMS: The E(3)-equivariant graph neural network architecture automatically preserves crystalline symmetries, yielding the correct acoustic‑sum‑rule zero modes without additional corrections.

NAME: MLIP
TYPE: cited_work

DIRECT_CLAIMS: LiFlow achieves speed‑ups of up to ~600,000× over ab initio molecular dynamics (and ~400× over MLIP), predicting a 1 ns trajectory in 48 s for a 2 × 2 × 1 LGPS supercell and 352 s for a 4 × 4 × 4 supercell.

DIRECT_CLAIMS: Non-conservative (unconstrained) MLIP models consistently show 2-3× theoretical speed-up over their conservative counterparts, with direct force prediction providing additional 2-3× speedup compared to forces computed via automatic differentiation.

DIRECT_CLAIMS: Elastic moduli predictions are very sensitive to the lack of energy conservation in MLIP models, and non-conservative models consistently perform worse on matbench-discovery downstream tasks despite achieving better training and validation accuracies.

DIRECT_CLAIMS: DFT setting inconsistency between training and evaluation datasets significantly affects MLIP model performance comparisons, with PET-OMAD performing worse than PET-OAM and PET-MPtrj on Inorganic Materials due to differences in ab initio theory levels.
ARTICLE: DeePMD-kit v2: A software package for Deep Potential models
